test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

Between the advantages of being an Indian citizen, freedom to worship one's own god is of utmost importance for the orthodox.

options.text: freedom to worship one's own god is
of utmost importance for the orthodox.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the use of the preposition "**Between**" in part A of the sentence.
 
• The preposition "**Between**" is generally used when referring to two distinct people, places, or things.
 
• The preposition "**Among**" is used when referring to more than two things or when talking about a collective group (like "the advantages").
 
• Since the sentence discusses one advantage out of a larger set of advantages of being a citizen, "**Among**" is the grammatically correct choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**Among** the advantages of being an Indian citizen, freedom to worship one's own god is of utmost importance for the orthodox."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "being an Indian citizen,"** – This part is grammatically correct as it functions as the object of the prepositional phrase.
 
• **Option 3: "freedom to worship one's own god is"** – This part is correctly structured; "freedom" is the singular subject, and "is" is the singular verb.
 
• **Option 4: "of utmost importance for the orthodox."** – This part correctly conveys the degree of importance for a specific group of people.
